run_rl_main_loop: run the RL main loop to play kuhn_poker with random agents for a specified number of episodes
create_rl_environment: create an open_spiel RL environment for a specified game with configurable number of players
build_random_agents: build a list of random agents for each player with the environment's action space
test_main_loop: test the main loop by running episodes with turn-based and simultaneous action modes
summarize_print_iteration: summarize the print_iteration function that logs time step info state rewards and actions
